title: Insulin action times

findings.where: Images 8 and 16; step "worked"; highlighted curve within the amber peak window
findings.title: Highlight fills reduce curve contrast below 4.5:1
findings.problem: Using the supplied theme tokens and opacities, the teal stroke against the combined amber band and teal area fill has approximately 3.5:1 contrast in light mode and 3.0:1 in dark mode. This falls below the project's specified 4.5:1 minimum.
findings.fix: Use the existing contrast-safe accent-ink token for the highlighted curve, retaining its dash pattern, or reduce the underlying fills. Check contrast against the composited backgrounds, not just the card background.

assessment: No verified clinical-range or clock-rollover error. The worked-example highlight fails the stated contrast requirement.
